text: NC is proud to support the SEBI versus
scam campaign, an initiative spearheaded
by the Securities and Exchange Board of
India to combat financial frauds and
scams in order to safeguard the
interests of investors in the Securities
Markets.
Seby's leadership in this campaign is
timely and critical. Scamsters are using
modern technology like fake trading
apps, unregulated chat groups, paid
courses with guaranteed returns, foreign
portfolio scams, etc., etc., to defraud
investors. Scammers prey on greed and
awareness is the only model
to combat these scams and stay safe. We
urge every investor to stay informed,
stay alert and stay protected
because in today's world, awareness is
your first line of defense. As an aware
investor, one should follow these four
important points.
Number one, do not fall for promises of
assured or fixed returns in the
securities market.
Number two, avoid unsolicited messages
from unknown sources. Always verify
information through official websites
such as SEBI, NSC, or the concerned
company. Number three, do not download
unregulated apps or join chat groups
offering investment advice. Download
trading apps only from SEBI registered
trading members via official app stores.
Number four, engage only with SEBI
registered intermediaries or research
analysts.
Let us work together under SEBI's
guidance to build a market that is not
only efficient but also a safer
marketplace. Thank you.
>> An investor awareness initiative by Sebi
